title.en: An Act to Provide for the Organization of the Municipal District of San Mariano, Province of Isabela, as a Regular Municipality.

text.en:
The municipal district of San Mariano, Province of Isabela, shall be converted into a regular
municipality governed by the provisions of chapter fifty-seven of the Administrative Code.

Upon the approval of this Act, the present president, vice-president, and councilors of said
district shall continue in office until their successors shall be duly elected in the general election of nineteen
hundred and twenty-eight.

The municipal district of San Mariano hereby converted into a regular municipality shall retain
the name of San Mariano and have the same territory and boundaries as heretofore.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 7, 1927.
